$comment: Recorded Devin MCP injection contracts, devin acp 3000.11.3 (9c803229faa4), live 2026-10-07. Sources: tmp/devin/probe/results/mcp-turn.json (parent run, scenarios stdioNative/diskOverlay/wireShapes.http) and tmp/devin/probe/results/mcp-turn-e2.json (lane E2 residuals: fresh-connection load after closing the lock holder, SSE transport, documented tool filters). Every recorded shape here produced a real tools/list + tools/call round trip inside a prompt turn unless noted otherwise.

stdio.$note: Native stdio injection; proven with env:[] (empty). Env-bearing stdio entries and an explicit type discriminator are spec-shaped but were not separately turn-proven — the tool-filter relay remains the production route.

http.$note: Spec-exact remote shape: type discriminator REQUIRED, headers as {name,value} objects (not a map). Earlier probes omitting `type` or sending header maps were rejected -32602 'data did not match any variant of untagged enum McpServer'.

sse.$note: Legacy SSE transport against a genuine MCP SSE endpoint (GET stream + endpoint event + POST target): initialize/tools/list/tools/call all observed on the SSE stream with the run nonce inside one prompt turn (tmp/devin/probe/results/mcp-turn-e2.json scenario sseTurn, 2026-10-07).

diskOverlayMcpConfig.$note: Private XDG_CONFIG_HOME overlay; stdio entries under mcpServers are proven (tools/list + tools/call in-turn). The documented disk shape for remote servers is {url, transport?: "http"|"sse", headers?: map} per tmp/devin/docs/cli/extensibility/mcp/configuration.md — the disk remote shape itself has not been turn-proven and must not be serialized for production until it is.

sessionLockedError.$note: Recorded -32015 on session/load while another live process holds the session; retryable, not a load failure. Closing the holder (lockHolderPid) releases the lock; after that a fresh-connection load succeeds (mcp-turn-e2.json scenario resumeLoad).
sessionLockedError.message: Session '<id>' is already open in another process (PID <pid>). Close the other instance before opening it here.

toolFilters.$note: Lane E2 filter run (tmp/devin/probe/results/mcp-turn-e2.json scenario toolFilter, 2026-10-07): overlay config.json carried both documented mechanisms. The injected MCP tool `probe_secret` was blocked by `permissions.deny` ("mcp__<server>__<tool>" pattern) at CALL time — the CLI logged `Permission decision for tool mcp__poracode-fixture__probe_secret: auto-decided Some(Deny) by cog` and the fixture server never received the tools/call. `disabled_tools` produced NO observable pre-call filtering of the injected MCP tool (the model still saw and attempted it). One run, one tool name: treat disabled_tools-on-MCP as unproven rather than disproven, and never rely on it for MCP tool hiding.
